articles.title: New Zealand delegation meets Chandigarh Mayor, MC Commissioner
articles.summary: A two-member delegation from New Zealand visited the Municipal Corporation, Chandigarh, and met Mayor Saurabh Joshi and MC Commissioner Amit Kumar to explore possibilities of establishing friendly relations between Chandigarh and Rotorua, New Zealand. The delegation comprised Dr Pim Borren, Chief Executive; and Paramdip Singh, Director, Special Projects, Toi Ohomai Institute of Technology, New Zealand.

articles.title: Young Indians Face Trust Deficit in Key State Institutions
articles.summary: Recent controversies involving the Election Commission of India and the National Testing Agency highlight a growing trust crisis among young citizens. Heavy police responses to youth protests fail to restore confidence in democratic systems. Experts suggest young Indians should channel their energy into constructive grassroots programs, drawing inspiration from Mahatma Gandhi and Jayaprakash Narayan to rebuild society alongside political resistance.
articles.title_hi: युवा भारतीयों को प्रमुख राज्य संस्थानों में भरोसे की कमी का सामना करना पड़ता है
articles.summary_hi: भारत के चुनाव आयोग और राष्ट्रीय परीक्षण एजेंसी से जुड़े हालिया विवाद युवा नागरिकों के बीच बढ़ते विश्वास संकट को उजागर करते हैं। युवाओं के विरोध प्रदर्शनों पर पुलिस की भारी प्रतिक्रिया लोकतांत्रिक प्रणालियों में विश्वास बहाल करने में विफल रही। विशेषज्ञों का सुझाव है कि युवा भारतीयों को राजनीतिक प्रतिरोध के साथ-साथ समाज के पुनर्निर्माण के लिए महात्मा गांधी और जयप्रकाश नारायण से प्रेरणा लेते हुए अपनी ऊर्जा रचनात्मक जमीनी स्तर के कार्यक्रमों में लगानी चाहिए।
articles.title_hinglish: yuva bharatiyon ko pramukha rajya sansthanon men bharose ki kami ka samana karana padata hai
articles.summary_hinglish: bharata ke chunava aayoga aura rashtriya parikshana ejensi se judaे haliya vivada yuva nagarikon ke bicha badhate vishvasa sankata ko ujagara karate hain। yuvaon ke virodha pradarshanon para pulisa ki bhari pratikriya lokatantrika pranaliyon men vishvasa bahala karane men viphala rahi। visheshajnyon ka sujhava hai ki yuva bharatiyon ko rajanitika pratirodha ke satha-satha samaja ke punarnirmana ke lie mahatma gandhi aura jayaprakasha narayana se prerana lete hue apani oorja rachanatmaka jamini stara ke karyakramon men lagani chahie।

With a proposed initial public offering of approximately ₹30,000 crore and a valuation potentially reaching ₹10. 3 lakh crore , Jio Platforms is positioning itself as something far more ambitious than India’s largest mobile telecom operator.

articles.title_hinglish: kya rilayansa jiyo vaishvika niveshakon ke samane khuda ko eka praudyogiki diggaja ke rupa men pesha kara sakata hai?

articles.title: Gurgaon overshot annual PM10 limit in April, 22 Haryana cities cross benchmark
articles.summary: It took just 101 days this year for Gurgaon to accumulate enough PM10 pollution to breach India’s annual air quality standard, with the city crossing the benchmark on April 11 — more than a month earlier than in 2025, when it did so on May 16, according to data shared by Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA).

articles.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi faces mounting political and economic pressure across India
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi faces growing political fatigue, rising youth unemployment, and public protests across Indian urban centers. Opposition parties are demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over electoral concerns. Meanwhile, economic distress, declining consumer confidence, and strained foreign relations have intensified pressure on the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party government, exposing widespread public discontent and institutional friction.
articles.title_hi: प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी पूरे भारत में बढ़ते राजनीतिक और आर्थिक दबाव का सामना कर रहे हैं

articles.title: Manipur violence kills 4; locals place bodies outside CM's house
articles.summary: In the first incident, violence erupted during a musical event in a locality inhabited by Meiteis and Pangal Muslims. A senior police official said that there were stone-pelting and gunfire. Several people were injured. A 24-year-old man later succumbed to bullet injuries. Officials said that villagers marched towards the CM's high-security bungalow in Imphal, carrying the bodies of the victims.

articles.title: BJP may drop 30-40% of Uttar Pradesh MLAs ahead of 2027 polls

articles.title: Bajaj Finance to introduce new term loan variants after RBI draft proposal on revolving
articles.summary: The RBI released draft guidelines back in August to ban revolving credit facilities offered by NBFCs other than those which offer credit cards. This would mean that flexi-loans, overdraft facilities, and repeat-draw facilities could come under pressure. Bajaj Finance has a notable exposure to revolver loans, about 15 percent of its assets under management (AUM).

articles.summary_hinglish: aaijol, 19 aktubar: mijorama pulisa ne 12 se 18 aktubara ke bicha rajya bhara men kaee abhiyanon men sandigdha avaidha rupa se parivahana kie gae urvarak, sukhi supari, videshi sigaret, sharaba aura methamaphetamaina jabta kiya hai। 19 aktubara ko jari eka pulisa presa bayana ke anusar, jabti men 75 lakh, 44 rupaye mulya ka 950 grama sandigdha methamaphetamaina shamila hai।

articles.title: U.S. Polo Assn Opens First New Identity Store in Puducherry
articles.summary: has opened a 1,700 sq ft store in Puducherry, marking the brand's first New Identity store in the city. The opening expands the American casualwear brand's retail presence in South India and introduces its updated store format to the local market. The store offers menswear and footwear from the brand's Autumn-Winter 2026 collection, including Varsity, Indigo, Corduroy, Denims and Shirts.
articles.title_hi: यूएस पोलो एसोसिएशन ने पुडुचेरी में पहला नया आइडेंटिटी स्टोर खोला
articles.summary_hi: ने पुडुचेरी में 1,700 वर्ग फुट का स्टोर खोला है, जो शहर में ब्रांड का पहला न्यू आइडेंटिटी स्टोर है। यह उद्घाटन दक्षिण भारत में अमेरिकी कैजुअलवियर ब्रांड की खुदरा उपस्थिति का विस्तार करता है और स्थानीय बाजार में इसके अद्यतन स्टोर प्रारूप को पेश करता है। स्टोर ब्रांड के ऑटम-विंटर 2026 कलेक्शन से मेन्सवियर और जूते पेश करता है, जिसमें वर्सिटी, इंडिगो, कॉरडरॉय, डेनिम्स और शर्ट्स शामिल हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: yuesa polo esosieshana ne puducheri men pahala naya aaidentiti stora khola
articles.summary_hinglish: ne puducheri men 1,700 varga phuta ka stora khola hai, jo shahara men branda ka pahala nyu aaidentiti stora hai। yaha udghatana dakshina bharata men ameriki kaijualaviyara branda ki khudara upasthiti ka vistara karata hai aura sthaniya bajara men isake adyatana stora prarupa ko pesha karata hai। stora branda ke ऑtama-vintara 2026 kalekshana se mensaviyara aura jute pesha karata hai, jisamen varsiti, indigo, koradaroy, denimsa aura shartsa shamila hain।

articles.title_hinglish: uttarakhanda ki dukanon ko 26 aktubara se mithaiyon ke pradarshana para 'upayoga ki tarikha' pradarshita karane ke lie kaha gaya hai
articles.summary_hinglish: isa kadama ka uddeshya bhojana ki tajagi ke bare men paradarshita men sudhara karana aura upabhoktaon ko kharidari ke bare men socha-samajhakara nirnaya lene men madada karana hai। aadesha ephadie aayukta vinaya shankara pande dvara jari kiya gaya hai, jisase dukanadaron ke lie una tre ya kauntaron para jahan aise utpada pradarshita kie jate hain, nirmana ki tarikha aura upabhoga ki antima tarikha ka spashta rupa se ullekha karana anivarya ho gaya hai।

articles.title: Ramesh Powar appointed to BCCI selection panel; Pragyan Ojha to chair committee
